definitions.explanation: A condition of having frequent loose or watery bowel movements.

examples.japanese: {下痢|げり}が{続|つづ}いている。
{食|た}べ{過|す}ぎて{下痢|げり}になった。
examples.english: I got diarrhea from eating too much.

examples.japanese: {下痢止|げりど}めを{飲|の}んだ。
{冷|つめ}たいものを{飲|の}みすぎて{下痢|げり}になった。
examples.english: I got diarrhea from drinking too many cold drinks.

examples.japanese: {下痢|げり}が{続|つづ}くなら{病院|びょういん}に{行|い}った{方|ほう}がいい。
examples.english: If the diarrhea continues, you should go to the hospital.

notes:
{下痢|げり} is a common medical condition. The opposite is {便秘|べんぴ} (constipation).

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {下痢|げり}をする/になる: to have diarrhea
- {下痢|げり}が{続|つづ}く: diarrhea continues
- {下痢止|げりど}め: anti-diarrhea medicine

RELATED WORDS:
- お{腹|なか}を{壊|こわ}す: to have an upset stomach
